_comment: Kit-only text that `devkit export` injects into core/ after copying from the harness.
The harness (~/.agents) does not carry these lines: they describe devkit profiles, where
AGENTS_HOME replaces ~/.agents. Without an overlay the next export would drop them.
path is relative to core/. The line equal to `after` is kept and `insert` is added below
it after a blank line. A missing anchor fails the export, so a harness rewrite cannot

overlays.after: When a command is not on PATH, look for it on ~/.local/bin and ~/.agents/bin.
overlays.insert: `~/.agents/` in any skill, rule, or KB text means the harness root: `$AGENTS_HOME` when set (a devkit profile), else `~/.agents`. Resolve it silently and use the real path. Do not tell the operator the file is "not at ~/.agents/…".
